notes: Search cap 8 used. Not independently re-retrieved (relied on author ledger of NHS who-can-take, other-medicines list beyond digoxin/methotrexate/St John's wort, common-questions page): Most-adults/children, the endoscopy/weight-loss list, cilostazol/antifungals/HIV/phenytoin/rifampicin, 'shortest time possible'. No alcohol content retrieved or stated. Breastfeeding: NHS (may be able to take after checking with doctor; probably too little in milk to harm) vs emc leaflets (not known whether in milk; should not be taken) both reported. Severe diarrhoea reworded to the NHS wording (talk to a doctor); liver/lupus now use NHS 'doctor or 111 straight away'. Removed unsupported 'can be stopped without reducing' and FAQ pharmacist line. Regulatory: Nexium Control title carries (P) (and a GSL version also exists); prescription status for Nexium 40 mg not stated in retrieved text (UK POM is textbook, kept in structural field only); no NHS regulatory statement. Monitoring: no routine tests retrieved; field describes NHS advice only. Nelfinavir and severe liver/kidney supported by emc leaflets (wording varies by leaflet); NSAID prevention supported by emc SmPC 4657. Article word count 670 (sections only).
